name: blinding spittle
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact.
Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
